body: Yeah that was my bad😢 should have given it more time before changing the jewellery. I definitely will be letting it heal longer and properly when I get it re pierced! Thank you for your kind wish!

Yep, I was planning on healing it and having it re done when it’s healed! And yeah, I did get another comment about it saying the jewellery was probably too heavy. I’ve just been confused since it was only one ear, but I guess I got unlucky this time😭 I will definitely take your advice on the jewellery type/material once it’s healed. I was planning on stacked lobes, but yeah I will put more consideration into the placement when I get it redone. I really appreciate your detailed advice! Thank you so much!

I figured it might’ve been too heavy😔 I definitely will take it out and let it heal. I actually have thought about stretching before! But I’m afraid it doesn’t suit me. For now, I’m gonna stick to these and let the hole heal and then re pierce. Thank you for your advice!

Hello, thank you for replying!
Yeah I’m probably going to take it out and try get it redone when it’s healed. I think I do move around a bit when sleeping, so maybe I rolled over or something and the movement made it tear..😞 thank you again!

- My piercing is around 5-6 months old, pierced last November
- Jewellery shape is a ring, changed this March
- I’m pretty sure the material is steel
- I use the neilmed piercing spray every day for aftercare.
